label: Takeaway
detail: Lawrence Tech went 19-29 and 10-18 in the WHAC as played. Its schedule lists 21-27 and 12-16, because two Apr 18 losses to Rochester Christian were later marked as forfeit wins. As the No. 7 seed it went 2-2 at the WHAC Tournament, beating No. 2 Indiana Tech 6-5. Its posted 2027 roster keeps 84% of 2026 plate appearances and 64% of innings. Hochendoner, a second-team All-WHAC starter, and Baird, the RBI leader, are not on it.

label: Method
detail: Back means a 2026 player whose name is on Lawrence Tech's posted 2027 roster. Everyone else who played counts as out, either as a listed senior or grad student or as not on the roster. A posted roster can still change before the season.

label: Season
detail: 19-29 followed 19-22 in 2025. Lawrence Tech scored 256 runs and allowed 287, hit .274 with 12 homers and posted a 5.45 ERA, per its official stats. It went 5-9 at home in Utica as played, 8-12 away and 6-8 at neutral sites, including 4-6 at the RussMatt tournament in Florida.

label: Postseason
detail: WHAC Tournament, Grand Rapids, Apr 30-May 2, as the No. 7 seed after Rochester Christian withdrew: beat No. 2 Indiana Tech 6-5, lost to Madonna 3-2, beat Northwestern Ohio 11-1, then lost to Indiana Tech 6-4.

label: lu_proj
detail: Built from 2026 box scores, using only players on the posted 2027 roster. Each spot goes to the returner with the most 2026 starts there. Order is by 2026 OPS, so small samples rank high. Set means 20 or more starts at the spot, Likely 8 or more. New names have no 2026 stats here, so none is in a projected spot.

label: lu_most
detail: A typical 2026 lineup, built from all 48 box scores. Each position goes to the player with the most starts there, using each player once and keeping as many of those starts as possible; the DH spot counts only starts at DH. The order is each player's average spot across all his 2026 starts, lowest first. No one started half the games at left (Martinkowski, 22), catcher (Rogers, 20), DH (Merz, 15), third (Parnell, 15) or second (McIntyre, 9), so those spots were shared. 2027 outlook is the same status used on the rest of this page.

label: lu_all
detail: Lawrence Tech used 46 different lineups in 48 games. A lineup counts as the same only with the same nine in the same order at the same positions.

label: rot_proj
detail: The same 2026 stats, with projected 2027 roles from the posted roster. Pitchers not on it made 16 of the 48 starts, including Hochendoner's 11 and Yeip's 4. New names have no 2026 stats here, so these are role guesses from 2026 usage.

label: Staff
detail: Main starters made at least 4 starts. Relievers made at least 5 relief outings and aren't main starters. GS and Relief are published totals.

label: Maps
detail: 39 of the 43 players with a listed hometown are from Michigan, 10 of them from Macomb County. The others list Ontario, Idaho, Illinois and Florida.

label: League
detail: Lawrence Tech ranked 9th of 11 WHAC teams in runs per game (5.33) and 1st in steals per game (2.85). On the mound it ranked 3rd in ERA (5.58) and 1st in homers allowed per nine (0.46).

label: Method
detail: wOBA uses standard big-league weights. FIP uses a constant that sets the NAIA-wide FIP equal to NAIA ERA. Rank 1 is best in every row. Lawrence Tech's numbers are from NAIA stats, which count the two Rochester Christian games as losses, and its WHAC rank is out of 11 teams because Rochester Christian isn't listed. NAIA stats and Lawrence Tech's own stats differ slightly, so a few figures here won't match its site.

label: Filter
detail: All games shows Lawrence Tech's published totals. Any other filter is added up from box scores and play-by-play, game by game. The filter changes the Hitters, Pitchers and Tendencies tabs. Player cards always show the full season.

label: Outing log
detail: Days of rest counts full calendar days since the pitcher's previous appearance, whatever the filter. Pitch counts show a dash when a box score lists none.

label: Ethan Hochendoner
detail: Hochendoner went 5-3 with a 3.29 ERA and struck out 91 in 63.0 innings, while opponents hit .188. He was second-team All-WHAC, beat Indiana Tech in the WHAC Tournament opener and is a listed senior who isn't on the 2027 roster.

label: Scoring
detail: Lawrence Tech scored 5.33 runs a game in NAIA stats, 9th of 11 in the WHAC and 153rd of 179 in the NAIA. It hit 12 homers all season, and Baird had 4 of them.

label: Speed
detail: 137 steals in 161 tries was 2.85 a game, 1st in the WHAC and 19th in the NAIA. Ty Schornak had 22, Rogers 18, Weinberger 15, Martinkowski 13, Lee 12 and Baird 11.

label: League play
detail: Lawrence Tech went 10-18 in the WHAC as played and was outscored 161-181, hitting .280 with a 6.18 ERA in those 28 games. It swept Michigan-Dearborn and Cornerstone and split with Northwestern Ohio, but lost all four at Indiana Tech and both to Aquinas and Rochester Christian.

label: The rotation
detail: Wright (3.36 ERA in 56.1 innings), Miller (3.52 in 38.1) and Coughlin (4.44 in 46.2) are back. The only other pitchers with 20 or more innings besides Hochendoner were Yeip (8.28) and Hedden (8.85).

label: Who is gone
detail: Players not on the 2027 roster had 270 of 1642 plate appearances, led by Baird and McIntyre, and 126.0 of 350.0 innings, led by Hochendoner, Yeip and Sayyae.

label: Catcher
detail: Andrew Merz made 23 starts here and is on the 2027 roster. Also: Brady Rogers 20 (back), Brady Doelle 5 (back).

label: First base
detail: Justin Baird made 29 starts here and is not on the 2027 roster. Also: Andrew Gingle 9 (back), Kyle Moore 5 (back).

label: Second base
detail: Brady Rogers made 14 starts here and is on the 2027 roster. Also: D'Andrea Parnell 11 (back), Evan McIntyre 9 (not back).

label: Shortstop
detail: Ty Schornak made 35 starts here and is on the 2027 roster. Also: Evan McIntyre 6 (not back).

label: Third base
detail: D'Andrea Parnell made 15 starts here and is on the 2027 roster. Also: Isaiah Logan 13 (back), Brayden Bess 13 (back).

label: Outfield
detail: Luke Weinberger 47 starts (back), Brady Lee 47 starts (back), Gavin Martinkowski 22 starts (back), Drew Schornak 15 starts (back), Justin Baird 10 starts (not on the 2027 roster).

label: Rotation
detail: Pitchers not on the 2027 roster made 16 of the 48 starts: Ethan Hochendoner 11, Zach Yeip 4, Tim Polidor 1. Wright (11), Coughlin (8) and Miller (8) are back.

label: Bullpen
detail: Donovan Sayyae 12 relief outings (not back), Nick McCormick 12 relief outings (not back), Owen Brown 9 relief outings (back), Isaiah Logan 9 relief outings (back), Jonathan Kurzawa 8 relief outings (back), Anthony Brohl 8 relief outings (back), Ryan Hurshe 7 relief outings (back), Tim Polidor 6 relief outings (not back).

label: On the 2027 roster
detail: 30 players from the 2026 roster, including Weinberger, Lee, Rogers, Ty Schornak, Merz, Wright, Coughlin and Miller.

label: Listed senior hitters not on it, 10 or more at-bats
detail: Justin Baird, Evan McIntyre.

label: Other hitters not on it, 10 or more at-bats
detail: Brady Osterhouse. Osterhouse was a listed freshman in 2026. His next stop isn't confirmed here.

label: Pitchers not on it, 10 or more innings
detail: Ethan Hochendoner (63.0 IP), Zach Yeip (25.0 IP), Donovan Sayyae (13.0 IP), Nick McCormick (12.0 IP). McCormick, a listed junior, had three saves. His next stop isn't confirmed here.

label: New names on the 2027 roster
detail: 14 players not on the 2026 roster page, listed on the Recruiting tab. 12 are listed as freshmen or redshirt freshmen. Three list a college: Jacob Brohl (Alpena CC), Donovan Heugh (Mid-Michigan CC) and Zach Patterson (Corban).

label: Stan Eldridge, head coach
detail: Hired Jan 30, 2015, when Lawrence Tech brought baseball back after more than 60 years; the program's first season was 2017. His bio lists earlier college stops at Spring Arbor, Siena Heights, Concordia (Ann Arbor) and Madonna, and the 2017 WHAC Champions of Character Coach award. The schedule pages add up to 212-211 over 10 seasons, counting 2026 as played.

label: Tom Compian, assistant coach
detail: His bio says he coaches outfielders and base running, and came from Henry Ford CC, where he was pitching coach.

label: Ryan Hilton, assistant coach
detail: His bio says he works with the pitching staff and was head coach at South Lyon East and an assistant at Oakland University.

label: Anthony Hermelyn, assistant coach
detail: His bio says he works with catchers and leads hitting, and that he was the 2015 Big 12 Catcher of the Year at Oklahoma and a fourth-round pick of the Houston Astros.

label: Jim Mancuso, Brad Roth and Anthony Puente, assistant coaches
detail: Mancuso works with pitchers and was head coach at U of D Jesuit. Roth was head coach at Homer High School and an assistant at Spring Arbor. Puente's bio has no details.

label: Ethan Hochendoner
detail: Second-team All-WHAC as a starting pitcher; WHAC Champions of Character team.

label: All-WHAC
detail: No other Lawrence Tech player made the first or second team, and none made the Gold Glove team or won a player award.

label: Where the roster comes from
detail: 39 of 43 list a Michigan hometown, 10 of them in Macomb County. One each lists Ontario, Idaho, Illinois and Florida.

label: How players arrive
detail: From the roster's Previous School column: 32 of 43 list no college before Lawrence Tech, 4 a two-year college (Alpena CC 2, Macomb CC 1, Henry Ford CC 1) and 7 a four-year school (Concordia in Ann Arbor, Georgetown, Tiffin, Eureka and Siena Heights). The roster lists one previous school per player.

label: Forfeits recorded as played
detail: Lawrence Tech's schedule lists both Apr 18 games with Rochester Christian as forfeit wins, because Rochester Christian used an ineligible player. Rochester Christian won them 7-0 and 8-3 on the field. Every record, score and line here counts them as played, the same way NAIA stats and Lawrence Tech's own stats page do. The schedule's 21-27 and 12-16 include the forfeits.

label: Official stats and box scores differ
detail: Season lines are Lawrence Tech's official ones; filters add up the box scores, which are also what NAIA stats uses. Official then box score: team hits 371, 366; earned runs allowed 212, 216; hits allowed 361, 369; errors 93, 87. NAIA stats lists 217 earned runs. For players, Weinberger has 47 hits officially and 45 in box scores, Lee 43 and 41, and Wright 21 earned runs officially and 28 in box scores.

label: Decisions worked out by elimination
detail: Eleven decisions aren't in the box scores, and the recaps that list decisions add none. Each fits the pitcher's published line: wins for Wright (Feb 21 9-4 and Mar 28 10-6), Coughlin (Mar 22 18-1) and Hochendoner (Mar 28 5-1), saves for Brown (Mar 28 5-1) and Logan (Apr 13 4-1), and losses for Miller (Mar 6 3-7, Mar 29 3-5), Yeip (Mar 6 0-9, Mar 21 4-7) and Hedden (Mar 29 5-14). Most are the only game that can. Logan's save is the one of his two possible games that meets the save rule. Yeip and Hedden both pitched in the Mar 6 0-9 and Mar 29 5-14 losses; Yeip started the Mar 6 game and allowed the first three runs of a shutout, so that loss is his and the Mar 29 one is Hedden's. One of McCormick's three saves can't be placed. The Mar 21 0-6 loss to Aquinas has no loss in the official totals either.

label: Some games have no real counts
detail: 13 of the 48 box scores have no usable counts, including all four Siena Heights games. Those games are left out of the count and pitch stats.

label: One game has no play-by-play
detail: The Mar 10 loss to John Melvin has a box score but no play-by-play. Its batting and pitching lines are in every total, but it adds nothing to the tendency, count and direction numbers.

label: Roster gaps
detail: The roster lists no state for most hometowns, so states come from each player's high school: Coldwater with Orillia Secondary is in Ontario, Eagle in Idaho, Montgomery in Illinois and Yulee in Florida, and the rest are in Michigan. Bats and throws are listed for only 16 of 43 players, so pull and opposite-field shares are blank for the rest. A Previous School of LTU or of the player's own high school is read as none.

label: Home and away
detail: Lawrence Tech's schedule lists the Apr 6 second game with Defiance as an away game, though both games were in Utica. Home, away and neutral records follow the schedule's listing; Lawrence Tech was 6-10 in Utica.

label: Map sources
detail: Hometowns are from Lawrence Tech's roster. I entered coordinates by hand, so towns are approximate, and Harper Creek is a school district near Battle Creek. Shapes come from U.S. Census and Natural Earth.

label: Checked by arithmetic
detail: The game log adds to 19-29, 256 runs scored and 287 allowed, and to 10-18 in WHAC games, matching NAIA stats. Line scores match those run totals. Official runs, walks, homers and doubles tie to the box scores; at-bats are 1,352 officially and 1,354 in box scores.

label: Box scores are from NAIA stats
detail: All 48 games are on NAIA stats, captured Nov 7, 2026. The WVU Tech scorer wrote some names last name first, "S. Ty" and "B. Brayden", which are read as Ty Schornak and Brayden Bess.

label: Projections
detail: Projected lineups and staffs come from public numbers and the posted roster. Lawrence Tech has published no depth chart.

label: Commits
detail: No commit list for Lawrence Tech was found. The Recruiting tab lists the new names on its 2027 roster instead.

label: Games that were not played
detail: Two games at Mount Vernon Nazarene on Feb 14, one at WVU Tech on Feb 22 and one at Trinity Christian on Feb 28 are listed as canceled. None is counted.

label: 2027 roster is a posted page, not a final one
detail: It lists 44 players, and the projections here use it as posted. Being off it doesn't confirm where a player went. Several returners are listed with new numbers, and Braden Lewis is listed as a grad student.

label: Spray charts are partial
detail: Spray charts use 929 of Lawrence Tech's 1,332 at-bats (70%): 92% of balls in play, 78% of hits (284 of 362) and 100% of everything else (645 of 647). Strikeouts have no direction. Scorers skip the direction on hits far more often than on outs, so charts can understate hits. Zones are where the scorer placed the ball, not exact spots.

label: Direction corrected
detail: Double plays were being credited to the relay throw instead of the first fielder, and plays written with the last name first or an error by a fielder had no direction. I corrected that on Nov 4, which moved Pull, Center and Oppo a few points for some hitters and raised the direction counts.

label: Runs by inning
detail: Lawrence Tech scored most in the 6th (55 runs) and 45 in the 1st. It scored 24 from the 7th on, though 7-inning games shorten that count.

label: Runs allowed
detail: Opponents scored most in the 3rd, 51 runs, and 121 in the first three innings.

label: Steals
detail: Play-by-play shows 92 steals of second, 38 of third and 2 of home, of 137 published.

label: Where Lawrence Tech has the edge
detail: Steals per game 2.85 to 1.44, ERA 5.58 to 5.70, FIP 5.82 to 6.11, walks plus hit batters per nine 6.79 to 7.29, homers allowed per nine 0.46 to 0.56.

label: Where Cleary has the edge
detail: Batting average .320 to .270, on-base percentage .433 to .378, slugging .453 to .361, OPS .886 to .739, wOBA .393 to .336, runs per game 7.69 to 5.33, homers per game 0.40 to 0.25, walk rate 13.4% to 10.6%, strikeout rate 14.1% to 20.1%, WHIP 1.58 to 1.63, strikeouts per nine 8.53 to 8.43, fielding percentage .968 to .941.

label: Series
detail: Cleary won three of four in Utica in 2026, 13-3 and 4-3 on Apr 3 and 12-9 on Apr 13, before Lawrence Tech won 4-1 later that day. Since 2019 Lawrence Tech leads 14-5, including one WHAC Tournament game, a 6-2 Lawrence Tech win in Grand Rapids on May 1, 2025.

label: Apr 3: Cleary 13, Lawrence Tech 3
detail: Wright started for Lawrence Tech (4.1 IP, 9 ER) and Seman for Cleary (5.2 IP, 3 ER). Baird went 1-for-3 for Lawrence Tech, and Wesley went 3-for-3 for Cleary.

label: Apr 3: Cleary 4, Lawrence Tech 3
detail: Hochendoner started for Lawrence Tech (7.1 IP, 4 ER) and Lieng for Cleary (2.0 IP, 1 ER). Baird went 3-for-4 for Lawrence Tech, and Seman went 2-for-4 for Cleary.

label: Apr 13: Cleary 12, Lawrence Tech 9
detail: Miller started for Lawrence Tech (3.0 IP, 5 ER) and Fay for Cleary (3.2 IP, 6 ER). Rogers went 2-for-3 for Lawrence Tech, and Seman went 3-for-3 for Cleary.

label: Apr 13: Lawrence Tech 4, Cleary 1
detail: Coughlin started for Lawrence Tech (6.0 IP, 1 ER) and Parris for Cleary (3.2 IP, 1 ER). Merz went 2-for-2 for Lawrence Tech, and Wesley went 3-for-4 for Cleary.

label: Method
detail: With All games selected, every number in this view counts all 48 games, from box scores and play-by-play. Ground outs include sacrifices and fielder's choices, and air outs include sacrifice flies.

label: Partial
detail: Scorers didn't enter these details for every game, so each number covers only part of the season. Treat them as samples. The first two tables show what's missing.

label: Splits
detail: Innings and time through the order use every plate appearance. Time through the order is each pitcher's batters faced in that game divided by nine, so substitutions can shift it slightly.

label: Splits
detail: Only plate appearances with a count listed. The count is where the plate appearance stood before its final pitch. Two strikes and Full count overlap the other rows.

label: Ground and air outs
detail: Weinberger has 1.34 ground outs per air out, the most among regulars (90 or more plate appearances), and Merz has 0.54.

label: How long arms go
detail: Hochendoner averages 5.5 innings a start, Wright 4.8, Coughlin 5.1 and Miller 4.2.

label: Groundball and fly-ball arms
detail: Hedden has 3.43 ground outs per air out, the most among pitchers with 100 batters faced, and Yeip has 0.64.

label: First-pitch swings
detail: Among regulars with pitch data on 60 or more plate appearances, Merz swings at the most first pitches, 45% on 110. Parnell swings at the fewest, 24% on 76.

label: Swing and miss
detail: Baird whiffs on 14% of swings, the fewest among regulars with pitch data on 60 or more plate appearances, and Merz on 42%.

label: Direction
detail: Baird pulls 52% of his batted balls, the most among regulars with a listed batting side, on 132 with a direction. Weinberger pulls 37%, on 125.

label: Pitch counts
detail: Hochendoner averages 97 pitches a start and Wright 78. Hochendoner's most was 130. Averages use only outings with a listed count.
